meta.description: Engagements between Imperial's central Research Software Engineering (RSE) team and departments. Every record carries a 'source' block: 'public' records are drawn from publicly available material and should be verified; 'mock' records are placeholders that illustrate the format and must be replaced with real data.

offeringTypes.label: Collaborative project
offeringTypes.description: Funded or costed software development work carried out with a research group.

offeringTypes.label: Code surgery
offeringTypes.description: Free 30-minute one-to-one consultations on research code (testing, packaging, optimisation and similar).

offeringTypes.label: Training & workshops
offeringTypes.description: Courses and workshops delivered to researchers, including Graduate School and Carpentries-style sessions.

offeringTypes.label: Hackathon / sprint
offeringTypes.description: Short, intensive development sprints or hackathons on a specific codebase.

offeringTypes.label: Community & outreach
offeringTypes.description: Talks, community events, newsletters and Slack support within the Research Software Community.

offeringTypes.label: Experience programme
offeringTypes.description: Placements and secondments such as the HPC and RSE Experience Programme.

offeringTypes.label: Open-source booster
offeringTypes.description: Free, short (under two days) collaborations to maximise the impact of open-source software developed at Imperial.

services.name: Code Surgeries
services.description: Free 30-minute slots, available fortnightly, for any Imperial researcher who writes or maintains software: version control, testing, code architecture, continuous integration, code review, optimisation, packaging and publication. Booked at least a week ahead so the team can review the code first.

services.name: Open-source booster
services.description: Free, short (under two days) collaborations on open-source Imperial software, choosing one of: paper pre-submission assessment, software deployment (PyPI / conda-forge), documentation infrastructure, or a quality and performance audit. Applicants are listed in the Imperial Research Software Directory.

services.name: Collaborative projects
services.description: Professional software development expertise provided to research projects, run under the team's standard operating procedure for project work.

services.name: Research Software Community
services.description: College-wide community of research software developers, supported by a Slack workspace and a regular newsletter.

services.name: HPC and RSE Experience Programme
services.description: Programme giving researchers hands-on experience of high-performance computing and research software engineering alongside the team.

services.name: Training
services.description: Training in research software engineering practice for researchers and research students.
